fusions.name: Hitchhiker Bite
fusions.desc: Flicks a hooked seed that leaps onto the first enemy it meets and deals 4 damage. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Mistletoe Latch
fusions.desc: A parasitic shoot latches onto one enemy and deals 18 damage, using up every affliction you have on it; each one used up adds 60% more damage. The target is left 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sprung Pod
fusions.desc: A seed pod bursts beneath you and flings you to a point up to 7 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Host Hopping
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
